    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChargePaymentToPaymentCharged" sourceRef="Activity_ChargePayment" targetRef="Event_PaymentCharged" />

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${route == 'charge'}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_ShippedExpress" name="Shipped express">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RouteToShippedExpress</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
